regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-one-narrative US regime (59% of themes eligible, absorption 0.32) with Cybersecurity as the lone crowded, trend-confirmed leader (durability 0.66, crowding z 1.94) and Silver Miners as the strongest uncrowded challenger (breadth 0.75). Momentum rank is a focus lens only; the absolute-trend gate is the sole validated edge (and it does help here), so I lean mostly with eligible trend-healthy themes and stay humble on rotation timing.
emerging_watch: Watching whether non-crowded Silver Miners (SIL) or Gold Miners (GDX) can post 5 consecutive days of outperformance over CIBR while Cybersecurity's crowding_z stays above 1.5 — that combination of confirmed relative strength plus wash-out in the crowded leader would retire the watch and mark a genuine uncrowded handoff.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is the highest-ranked eligible theme that is NOT crowded (crowding z 0.42, crowded false) with the broadest internal participation in the top decile (breadth 0.75). It sits right behind the crowded Cybersecurity leader with a much healthier crowding texture, so it is the cleaner trend-following expression of the eligible set — not a momentum-return forecast, but a durable, uncrowded continuation candidate under the only validated leg (absolute-trend gate eligibility).
evidence: hurts tag 'mixed' but absolute-trend gate eligible
theses.dissent: Silver Miners is a high-beta industrial-metals name with no unique fundamental catalyst; if precious metals sentiment rolls over broadly, the uncrowded breadth does nothing to cushion absolute losses, and mixed Hurst suggests the trend is not cleanly established.

falsifier.text: SIL breaks back below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners offers the broadest participation in the entire eligible universe (breadth 0.917) with the highest durability bar of any top-5 theme (0.70) and effectively zero crowding (z 0.15). This is the most internally-confirmed trend-healthy theme available, and trend-gate eligibility is intact — a classic high-breadth, durable, uncrowded continuation setup rather than a crowded momentum chase.
theses.dissent: Gold miners are deeply tied to real rates and the dollar; a hawkish repricing or a dollar surge would hit GDX regardless of the clean breadth/durability profile, and the theme is mid-ranked so it may simply not lead rotation.

falsifier.text: GDX underperforms SPY by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the confirmed trend leader (rank 1, Hurst 'trend', durability 0.66, val_state 'confirming') and the absolute-trend gate is satisfied. The crowding flag (z 1.94, crowded true) is a size-down caution, NOT a fade or sell — per guardrails, I cap conviction but do not fight the dominant theme. The lean is a continuation read on the trend-healthy leader, explicitly not a return forecast from the momentum rank.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z~1.94 and breadth of just 0.5 mean the leader is concentrated in a narrow set of names; leadership can persist but is vulnerable to a sharp internal unwind absent new catalyst, and the rank itself has no forward return edge.

falsifier.text: CIBR lags SPY by 5% over any rolling 5-day period before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
